Grades and averages

For students who want to know where they stand. Your years, terms or semesters, teaching units and subjects with their coefficients or ECTS credits; each grade with its own scale and weight (tests, exams, orals). Weighted averages by subject, unit, term and year, credits earned, using the rules of your degree that you enter yourself (pass mark, compensation, eliminatory grade, resit, honours). The simulator gives the grade you need at the upcoming exams to reach your target. Average over time and a printable transcript. No official grading scheme built in.
